# Ritushka — Contemporary Abstract Landscape & Seascape Artist

> Ritushka is a contemporary abstract artist based in Lane Cove, Sydney, Australia, creating large-scale abstract landscapes and seascapes. Original paintings and commissions for art collectors, interior designers, architects, property developers and corporate buyers. Worldwide insured shipping with certificate of authenticity.

## Key facts
- Artist: Ritushka
- Discipline: Abstract landscape & seascape painting, large-scale contemporary works
- Location: Lane Cove, Sydney, NSW, Australia
- Offers: Original artworks, commissioned paintings, trade programs (interior designers, art consultants, buyer's agents, corporate)
- Shipping: Worldwide, insured, certificate of authenticity
